facts.material: polyester tape blade, ABS and steel housing, magnet on end hook
facts.form: complete retractable tape measure, inch/cm graduated

gri_path: GRI 1: heading 9017 covers instruments for measuring length, for use in the hand (for example measuring rods and tapes); chapter 90 notes do not exclude it

rejected_alternatives.reason: micrometers, calipers and gauges; a tape is not one of these
parts and accessories; this is a complete instrument

classification.rationale: A retractable tape measure is a hand-held length-measuring tape named in heading 9017; the only 9017.80 line is 9017.80.00.00 (Other instruments). No classification ruling with a code was returned for this good; the two tape-measure origin rulings found carry no codes, so none is cited.
